note: Monsters now carry special abilities: wolves snap twice per attack, bandits land triple dagger strikes, ogres and trolls fly into a rage when badly hurt and hit harder and move faster, and dragons strike four times, hunt you across a wider territory, and ignore townsfolk to come for you alone. Slimes stay close to home and never notice a sneaking player, spiders also ignore sneaking prey, and rats, bats, snakes, and deer flee faster than before. Rampage is not in: the game has no multi-target melee to build it on, and no effect immunities exist yet because nothing overworld slows, stuns, or fears anything.
